description: This header file declares internal API functions related to the Http Pso Ver2 object, which appears to be part of an HTTP protocol implementation for a BroadWay service system. It includes function prototypes for state management, operation control, resource management, and client interaction specific to the Http Pso Ver2 component.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2Return
methods.description: Returns the object to its pool or cleanup.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2Reset
methods.description: Resets the object to a clean state.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2Open
methods.description: Initializes or opens the Pso Ver2 object.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2Close
methods.description: Closes or cleans up the Pso Ver2 object.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2AcquireAccess
methods.description: Acquires necessary access for the object.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2AskTroBySocket
methods.description: Gets the transaction request object associated with a socket.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2PopTroBySocket
methods.description: Removes the transaction request object associated with a socket.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2GetLastTro
methods.description: Retrieves the last transaction request object.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2GetCurTro
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction request object.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2AddNewTro
methods.description: Creates and adds a new transaction request object.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2QueryForClient
methods.description: Query data from client, returns a result size.

methods.name: HttpPsoVer2FinishedByClient
methods.description: Indicates completion of client data processing.
